scoring_justification: All scored quantities can be recomputed directly from the agent's raw artifacts using the paper's closed-form equations, without needing any precomputed golden file. The checker implements the analytical model and compares the agent's outputs within tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Analytical formulas from the paper for thermoelectric cooler model (Eqs. 1–22) and the example material constants (§4 Illustration).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived directly from the paper's text; the formulas are the same ones used to produce the paper's own numerical results.
hidden_assets.generation_method: The checker implements the mathematical model in Python (numpy + scipy.optimize); no external data or lookup tables are needed.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact analytical relationships the paper derived and used; they are not invented by the grader.
